column1: @ SELECT hex(substr(n.value, 1, 1)) AS h, CAST(c.contributor AS TEXT) AS contributor, c.nightly, c.target, c.result, c.time FROM contributions c JOIN names n ON n.id = c.artifact ORDER BY n.value, c.nightly, c.target, c.contributor
@ SELECT CAST(contributor AS TEXT), counted, first, agreed, disagreed, unconfirmed, first_time, last_time FROM contributor_totals ORDER BY contributor
@ SELECT contributor, login, tokens_after, first_time, last_time FROM contributors ORDER BY contributor
@ SELECT CAST(machine AS TEXT), contributor, time FROM links ORDER BY machine

@ SELECT hex(substr(n.value, 1, 1)) AS h, x.nightly, x.target, CAST(x.talon_version AS TEXT), x.pass_count, x.fail_count, x.crash_count, x.first_time, x.last_time FROM compat_hints x JOIN names n ON n.id = x.artifact ORDER BY n.value, x.nightly, x.target, x.talon_version
